transcript.text: Can you describe your role and key responsibilities as Programme Coordinator at the education NGO?

I taught for four years at a private school in Hyderabad and for the last two years I've coordinated a remedial-learning programme for an education NGO. It runs in 18 government schools, four field staff report to me, and we manage Rs 55 lakh from two donors. Over two years the share of children reading at grade level went from 31% to 48%. I'm applying for an MBA because I know how learning improves but I can't yet scale a programme or read a budget properly.
How did you manage and support your team of 4 field staff in running the remedial-learning programme?
transcript.anchor_quote: four field staff report to me

transcript.text: Education is the foundation of society. Through my work I try to empower children and create sustainable impact. I believe in holistic development and inclusive growth.
You mentioned managing four field staff for the remedial-learning programme. Could you share specific ways you supported them operationally and helped them overcome challenges?
transcript.anchor_quote: four field staff report to me

transcript.text: I don't know how the 48% figure compares with other NGOs working in the same districts. We compared ourselves only with our own baseline.
Could you describe a specific challenge you or your team faced while running the remedial-learning programme, and how you addressed it?
transcript.anchor_quote: I don't know how the 48% figure compares with other NGOs working in the same districts. We compared ourselves only with our own baseline

transcript.text: I don't actually have anyone reporting to me. The four field staff report to the director, and I only share the schedule with them.

You mentioned that the four field staff report to the director, and you share the schedule with them. Could you clarify your role in coordinating the programme and how you interact with those field staff in your current position?
By the way, have you heard about the new metro line in Hyderabad? My commute to the schools could be shorter. I'm thinking of moving closer to the station.

feedback.summary: The candidate provided a clear overview of their role and impact on the remedial-learning programme, including management of budget and programme scale. However, there was significant confusion regarding direct supervisory responsibilities and team management, leading to inconsistent statements about reporting lines. The candidate also missed opportunities to detail personal contributions, specific challenges, and lessons learned. Responses to follow-up questions lacked operational details and examples of leadership or problem solving. Motivations were articulated in broad terms but without linking to specific actions or learnings. Career rationale and contribution areas were partially addressed but need deeper reflection and substantiation.

strengths.quote: It runs in 18 government schools, four field staff report to me, and we manage Rs 55 lakh from two donors. Over two years the share of children reading at grade level went from 31% to 48%
strengths.observation: Provided quantitative evidence of programme scale, budget responsibility, and measurable outcome improvement, demonstrating awareness of impact and scope.

improvements.quote: I don't actually have anyone reporting to me. The four field staff report to the director, and I only share the schedule with them
improvements.observation: Contradicted earlier claim about direct line reports, indicating a lack of clarity on actual leadership role and personal ownership of team management.
improvements.suggestion: Practice succinctly describing your actual role and relationship with team members, clarifying your operational responsibilities versus formal reporting lines; for example, explain how you coordinate and influence the team without direct authority.

improvements.quote: Education is the foundation of society. Through my work I try to empower children and create sustainable impact. I believe in holistic development and inclusive growth
improvements.observation: Provided a generalized motivation statement without connecting to specific actions, decisions or experiences that illustrate these values in practice.
improvements.suggestion: Prepare a 60-second story linking your motivation to a concrete situation where you demonstrated these values through a tough choice or initiative.

improvements.quote: I don't know how the 48% figure compares with other NGOs working in the same districts. We compared ourselves only with our own baseline
improvements.observation: Did not provide insight into challenges faced or learning from setbacks; deferred comparative evaluation without elaboration on trade-offs or judgment.
improvements.suggestion: Identify and rehearse an example of a challenge your team faced, your decision-making process, and what you learned to share with specific details.

feedback.next_exercise: Take the example of the remedial-learning programme and retell in 60 seconds: 1) your exact role and scope, 2) a specific challenge faced, 3) a decision you made with an alternative you rejected, and 4) the outcome and what you learned from it.
